ValidationRule.description: Identification Type is mandatory when Stage is not Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c),
OR( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "RES_Residential_Single_Buyer", $RecordType.DeveloperName = "RES_Residential_Multi_Buyer" ),
NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Pending") ) ),
ISBLANK(TEXT(RES_Identification_Type__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Identification Type is mandatory when Stage is not Closed Lost.
